title: NYC Uber rider fare forecasting
timestamp_convention: UTC-naive storage; America/New_York calendar features and display
horizon_definition: h=1 predicts pickup bin starting at origin; h=3 at origin+2h; h=6 at origin+5h
history_rule: Only pickup bins strictly earlier than origin minus 3 hours; last available bin starts at origin minus 4 hours. Eligible trips last at most 3 hours.
target: Median base_passenger_fare in USD for completed nonshared Uber trips within a fixed origin-destination zone pair; not an isolated surge component or binding upfront quote
route_selection: Six routes selected using January data only, before validation/test processing
high_fare_threshold: Route-specific 90th percentile of valid TRAIN hourly median fares, fixed before validation/test scoring

synthetic_extension.purpose: Test observable forecasting transfer from an explicitly stylized price/ETA/queue simulator; separate from illustrative policy scenarios
synthetic_extension.paper: Buchholz, Doval, Kastl, Matejka and Salz (2025), Personalized Pricing and the Value of Time, Econometrica 93(3):929-958, DOI 10.3982/ECTA18838
synthetic_extension.gradient_data: Synthetic episodes only; real train-only data may calibrate observable fare/count scales, not identify structural preferences or supply
synthetic_extension.selection: Choose step30 or step60 solely by February MAE. Evaluate that candidate beside both frozen original variants in March; preserve zero-shot if adaptation fails. No test-driven reruns.

chronos_covariates: Known-future NYC hour/day sine/cosine and weekend; past-only completed-trip count. Same calendar/count information available to learned baselines.
benchmark_selection: Baseline hyperparameters and named baseline/Chronos comparison selected by validation MAE only. Selected learned baselines refit once on train+validation before test. No test tuning.
intervals: Chronos native 10th/90th quantiles; baseline intervals use frozen validation residual 10th/90th percentiles by model and horizon. Empirical coverage is reported, not guaranteed.
bootstrap: 2000 paired daily-block bootstrap draws with seed 20261026; descriptive uncertainty for this one city/month, not deployment generalization
limitations: Historical pseudo-online replay assumes an internal completed-trip feed; public TLC files arrive monthly with publication delay and cannot run this live.
Completed-trip selection excludes abandoned quotes and unmet demand. Volume is served trips, not unconstrained demand.
No Uber One membership, trip-product tier, explicit surge, competitor prices, or rider-level treatment information.
Fare changes can reflect route/product/rider mix, duration, and pricing. Fixed OD and filters do not eliminate composition changes.
Predictive performance does not identify price elasticities, causal subscription effects, optimal surge, or improvement over Uber production models.
No economic fine-tuned research weights are reused. Original public Chronos-2 weights only.
